class.name: LatexLabel
class.brief_description: Displays a LaTeX math expression using MicroTeX.
class.description: Enter an expression such as [code]\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}[/code] in [member text]. [LatexLabel] uses embedded math fonts and draws the result on the Godot canvas. Its minimum size follows the dimensions of the formula. To change the size or color, override the [code]font_size[/code] or [code]font_color[/code] theme item. The default values come from the [Label] theme.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the error from the last attempt to lay out [member text]. Returns an empty string if the expression rendered successfully or is empty. The label lays out its expression after entering the scene tree.

members.member: Uses display math style when enabled and the more compact inline math style when disabled.
The LaTeX expression to display. Supply the formula directly, for example [code]\sum_{n=1}^{10} n^2[/code].
